messages:
Asha: Quick FYI - I found a broken link in the KB page about dedicated capacity that points to /deployments/private (404). Seen on prod via support ticket. Can someone pick this up?

DocsBot: New support alert: ticket #SUP-8893 references docs link /kb/dedicated -> /deployments/private (404). Auto-triage: docs-owner-maybe.

Tom: I can look. Probably the section moved under /deployments/enterprise in the last restructure.

Asha: Thanks @Tom. If it's a move, prefer a 301 redirect from the old path and a TOC update in the KB so external links don't break. Also flag for legal if wording changed.

Nate: Heads-up on i18n - when you change paths, localized versions sometimes still point to old slugs. @Tom please cc me on the PR so I can grep ja/ zh/ locales.

Tom: Quick local repro steps:
```
# check current site tree
rg "deployments/private" -n docs/ || true
# find pages linking to old path
rg "deployments/private" docs/ -S
```
I'll open a branch `docs/fix/redirect-deploy-private-1766019999` and push a tiny redirect in _redirects.toml plus update the KB toc.

Asha: Perfect. Leave the PR as small. Mark it high priority since support ticket is active.

LinkCheckBot: LinkCheckBot: scanned /kb today, found 1 broken path -> /deployments/private. Report LCB-2026-1982. Suggested action: add redirect or update references.

Tom: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1101 - adds redirect and updates internal links (2 files). @Nate @Asha PTAL. CI will run linkcheck job.

Nate: Looking now. One nit: update the canonical frontmatter on the new target if needed (we've had search scoring oddness when the canonical slug mismatches). I'll leave a quick comment on the PR.

Asha: Reviewed and approved. CI flagged one remaining reference in examples/snippets.md - I pushed a tiny commit to fix that.

Tom: Merged. Redirect added and links updated. Closing support ticket. Re-run full linkcheck job later today to spot any other fallout.

DocsBot: Support ticket #SUP-8893 resolved by PR #1101. Notifying ticket owner.

LinkCheckBot: Scheduled re-scan: /kb at 2026-03-15T08:00:00Z.
